descriptor: Yuna is a 6-year-old girl. She has light golden skin. Her hair is straight and black, worn in two low pigtails, with a blunt fringe cut straight across above the eyebrows. Her eyes are dark brown, almond-shaped with gentle monolids. She has a tiny dark mole just below the LEFT eye. She looks like a real child, drawn with specific, individual features — never a generic cartoon and never in an anime or manga style.
wardrobe_default: simple, comfortable everyday clothes with terracotta as the recurring accent — for example a terracotta cardigan, jumper or boots.
companion: A small round magpie, about the size of a teapot, with a glossy black head and back, a crisp white belly and blue-sheen tail feathers, wearing a small knitted terracotta scarf.

descriptor: Theo is a 6-year-old boy. He has fair skin with warm peach undertones. His hair is softly wavy and light brown, cut short and neat, close to the head, with a side-swept fringe falling across one eyebrow. His eyes are green, large and round. He wears round glasses with sage green rims. He has a light scatter of freckles across the nose and cheeks. He looks like a real child, drawn with specific, individual features — never a generic cartoon and never in an anime or manga style.
wardrobe_default: simple, comfortable everyday clothes with sage green as the recurring accent — for example a sage green cardigan, jumper or boots.
companion: A small round fox cub, about the size of a teapot, with russet fur, a white-tipped brushy tail and bright dark eyes, wearing a small knitted sage green scarf.
